title: Sunday · Dog Night, 2007
logline: Eight years. The alley behind the Lanes, the sign all lit, the dumpster, the walk in three tiers with the dog leading each one.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the bowling alley's sign fully lit over the alley in rain.

image.prompt: a bowling alley's neon sign fully lit above a rainy alley at night, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Sign

panels.composition: Tier 2: a man and a dog walking the alley, the dog ahead at the leash's length.

image.prompt: a man in a canvas chore coat walking a dog on a leash down a wet alley at night with the dog ahead, watercolor

panels.name: Walk

panels.composition: Tier 3: the dumpster, the dog's nose to its corner, the man waiting. Eight years.

image.prompt: a dog sniffing a dumpster's corner in a rainy alley while a man waits holding the leash, watercolor

panels.name: Dumpster

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving
